arxiv-2003-05489.title: SWIFT: Scalable Ultra-Wideband Sub-Nanosecond Wavelength Switching for Data Centre Networks
arxiv-2003-05489.description: Abstract We propose a time-multiplexed DS-DBR/SOA-gated system to deliver low-power fast tuning across S-/C-/L-bands. Sub-ns switching is demonstrated, supporting 122 × \times 50 GHz channels over 6.05 THz using AI techniques. Thomas Gerard*, Christopher Parsonson, Zacharaya Shabka, Polina Bayvel, Domaniç Lavery and Georgios Zervas Optical Networks Group, Dept. of Electronic and Electrical Engineering, University College London, London, UK, WC1E 7JE.

arxiv-2010-04994.title: A Locally Conservative Mixed Finite Element Framework for Coupled Hydro-Mechanical-Chemical Processes in Heterogeneous Porous Media Journal: Elsevier
arxiv-2010-04994.creator: T. Kadeethum, S. Lee, F. Ballarin, J. Choo, H.M. Nick
arxiv-2010-04994.description: Abstract This paper presents a mixed finite element framework for coupled hydro-mechanical-chemical processes in heterogeneous porous media. The framework combines two types of locally conservative discretization schemes: (1) an enriched Galerkin method for reactive flow, and (2) a three-field mixed finite element method for coupled fluid flow and solid deformation.

arxiv-2210-09937.title: Wijesekera-style constructive modal logics
arxiv-2210-09937.creator: Tiziano Dalmonte
arxiv-2210-09937.description: Abstract We define a family of propositional constructive modal logics corresponding each to a different classical modal system. The logics are defined in the style of Wijesekera’s constructive modal logic [ 38 ] , and are both proof-theoretically and semantically motivated. On the one hand, they correspond to the single-succedent restriction of standard sequent calculi for classical modal logics.

arxiv-2308-09607.title: PeV Gamma-ray Astronomy With Panoramic Optical SETI Telescopes
arxiv-2308-09607.creator: Shelley A. Wright
arxiv-2308-09607.description: Abstract The Panoramic Search for Extraterrestrial Intelligence (PANOSETI) experiment is designed to detect pulsed optical signals on nanosecond timescales. PANOSETI is therefore sensitive to Cherenkov radiation generated by extensive air showers, and can be used for gamma-ray astronomy. Each PANOSETI telescope uses a 0.

arxiv-2308-14168.title: A Bayesian Projection of the Total Fertility Rate of Puerto Rico: 2020-2050 First Version
arxiv-2308-14168.creator: Angélica M. Rosario Santos*, Hernando Mattei**, Luis Pericchi Guerra*
arxiv-2308-14168.description: Abstract . The abrupt decline in the Total Fertility Rate (TFR) of Puerto Rico since 2000 makes the prospect of a sustained population decline a real possibility. From 2000 to 2021 the TFR declined from 2.1 to 0.9 children per woman, one of the lowest in the world.

arxiv-2508-09616.title: MInDI-3D: Iterative Deep Learning in 3D for Sparse-view Cone Beam Computed Tomography
arxiv-2508-09616.creator: Daniel Barco, Marc Stadelmann, Martin Oswald, Ivo Herzig, Lukas Lichtensteiger, Pascal Paysan, Igor Peterlik, Michal Walczak, Bjoern Menze, Frank-Peter Schilling
arxiv-2508-09616.description: Abstract Reducing patient radiation exposure in Cone Beam Computed Tomography (CBCT) by acquiring fewer projections introduces severe image artefacts, limiting its clinical utility. To address this challenge, we propose MInDI-3D ( M edical In version by D irect I teration in 3D ), a 3D conditional diffusion framework that restores volumetric data from sparse-view inputs.

arxiv-2509-02771.title: Analysis of Speaker Verification Performance Trade-offs with Neural Audio Codec Transmission
arxiv-2509-02771.creator: \authorblockN Nirmalya Mallick Thakur \authorrefmark 1 and Jia Qi Yip \authorrefmark 2 \authorrefmark 3 and Eng Siong Chng \authorrefmark 2 \authorblockA \authorrefmark 1 Indian Institute of Science Education and Research, Bhopal \authorblockA \authorrefmark 2 Nanyang Technological University, Singa
arxiv-2509-02771.description: Abstract Neural audio codecs (NACs) have made significant advancements in recent years and are rapidly being adopted in many audio processing pipelines. However, they can introduce audio distortions which degrade speaker verification (SV) performance. This study investigates the impact of both traditional and neural audio codecs at varying bitrates on three state-of-the-art SV models evaluated on the VoxCeleb1 dataset.

arxiv-2601-04774.title: First measurement of the Hubble constant from a combined weak lensing and gravitational-wave standard siren analysis
arxiv-2601-04774.creator: Felipe Andrade-Oliveira, David Sanchez-Cid, Danny Laghi, Marcelle Soares-Santos
arxiv-2601-04774.description: Abstract We present a new measurement of the Hubble constant ( H 0 H_{0} ) resulting from the first joint analysis of standard sirens with weak gravitational lensing and galaxy clustering observables comprising three two-point correlation functions (3 × \times 2pt).

pmc-10531877.title: Therapeutic Anti-KIR Antibody of 1–7F9 Attenuates the Antitumor Effects of Expanded and Activated Human Primary Natural Killer Cells on In Vitro Glioblastoma-like Cells and Orthotopic Tumors Derived Therefrom
pmc-10531877.creator: Ryosuke Maeoka, Tsutomu Nakazawa, Ryosuke Matsuda, Takayuki Morimoto, Yoichi Shida, Shuichi Yamada, Fumihiko Nishimura, Mitsutoshi Nakamura, Ichiro Nakagawa, Young-Soo Park, Takahiro Tsujimura, Hiroyuki Nakase, Chiara Laezza
pmc-10531877.description: Glioblastoma (GBM) is the leading malignant intracranial tumor, where prognosis for which has remained extremely poor for two decades. Immunotherapy has recently drawn attention as a cancer treatment, including for GBM. Natural killer (NK) cells are immune cells that attack cancer cells directly and produce antitumor immunity-related cytokines.

pmc-10567728.title: Targeted imaging of uPAR expression in vivo with cyclic AE105 variants
pmc-10567728.creator: Julie Maja Leth, Estella Anne Newcombe, Anne Louise Grønnemose, Jesper Tranekjær Jørgensen, Katrine Qvist, Anne Skovsbo Clausen, Line Bruhn Schneider Knudsen, Andreas Kjaer, Birthe Brandt Kragelund, Thomas Jørgen Dyreborg Jørgensen, Michael Ploug
pmc-10567728.description: A comprehensive literature reports on the correlation between elevated levels of urokinase-type plasminogen activator receptor (uPAR) and the severity of diseases with chronic inflammation including solid cancers. Molecular imaging is widely used as a non-invasive method to locate disease dissemination via full body scans and to stratify patients for targeted treatment.

pmc-11568236.title: Exploring the Influence of Age at Menarche on Metabolic Syndrome and Its Components Across Different Women's Birth Cohorts
pmc-11568236.creator: Maryam Farahmand, Maryam Mousavi, Fereidoun Azizi, Fahimeh Ramezani Tehrani
pmc-11568236.description: PurposeMetabolic syndrome (MetS) is the primary cardiovascular risk factor, making it a global issue. Our objective was to assess the association between the age at menarche (AAM) and MetS and its components in different generations of women.MethodsIn this cross‐sectional study, 5500 eligible women aged ≥ 20 who participated in the Tehran lipid and glucose study in 2015–2017 were selected.

pmc-12522466.title: A pragmatic, randomised, open-label, multi-centre UK registry-facilitated trial evaluating the effect of high-dose cholecalciferol on mortality in patients on dialysis: the SIMPLIFIED trial
pmc-12522466.creator: Toby J. L. Humphrey, Fergus J. Caskey, David C. Wheeler, Ian B. Wilkinson, Edward C. F. Wilson, Adam P. Wagner, Francis Dowling, Barbara Vencilas, Molly Cui, Simon J. Bond, Thomas F. Hiemstra, Rona M. Smith
pmc-12522466.description: BackgroundVitamin D deficiency is common in patients with end stage kidney disease (ESKD) and is a strong predictor of death from cardiovascular disease, infections and cancer. Currently only 68% of patients in the UK survive 3 years or more on dialysis. Vitamin D replacement typically utilises activated (1α-hydroxylated) vitamin D compounds allowing for impaired renal activation.

pmc-12558382.title: Plastic-binding peptides as anchors for protein scaffolds on synthetic plastics: opportunities and challenges
pmc-12558382.creator: Sreeahila Retnadhas, Eric L. Hegg, Daniel C. Ducat
pmc-12558382.description: Non-biodegradable synthetic plastics are accumulating in the environment and current recycling methods are limited by harsh processing conditions and inferior quality of recycled products. While biological approaches to plastic degradation offer promise, available enzymes remain inefficient at degrading synthetic plastics due to their inherent physical and chemical properties.

pmc-12978007.title: Hepatic Viral Reservoirs in Concurrent HIV and HBV: From Mechanistic Insight to Integrated Cure Strategies
pmc-12978007.creator: Renato Bobadilla, Finn MacLean, Shravan Dave, Jason T Blackard, Sara Gianella
pmc-12978007.description: Purpose of ReviewConcurrent HIV and hepatitis B virus (HBV) affect an estimated 4–5 million people worldwide and remain a major driver of liver-related morbidity and mortality, even among individuals receiving tenofovir-containing antiretroviral therapy (ART). Both viruses establish long-lived reservoirs that are not eliminated by current antiviral therapies.

pmc-12988484.title: Malnutrition in gastrointestinal cancer manifests before systemic therapy and is associated with fatigue and reduced physical quality of life
pmc-12988484.creator: Mats L Wiese, Lena Schwarz, Sabrina von Rheinbaben, Sebastian Schmidt, Markus Blaurock, Jan Krönke, Markus M Lerch, Luzia Valentini, Ali A Aghdassi
pmc-12988484.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundThere is a high malnutrition risk in patients with gastrointestinal tumors. Yet it is unknown when malnutrition manifests and how changes in nutritional status are related to quality of life and fatigue at different stages of oncologic therapy.Patients and MethodsIn a prospective observational study, we recruited patients with initial diagnosis of any gastrointestinal tumor requiring systemic therapy and respective patients already receiving treatment. Subjects underwent comprehensive nutritional assessment at enrollment and after 3 months.

pmc-13079882.title: Decreased potential for lymphatic vessel generation is a hallmark of early diagnosed arterial hypertension and can be reversed by treatment with angiotensin converting enzyme inhibitors
pmc-13079882.creator: Mateusz Gliwiński, Tomasz Koliński, Zuzanna Urban-Wójciuk, Maciej Zieliński, Karolina Piekarska, Małgorzata Fraściszewska, Anna Żyłko, Rafał Pęksa, Joanna Karczewska, Grażyna Peszyńska-Sularz, Bartosz Trzeciak, Andrzej Molisz, Piotr Gutknecht, Magdalena Reiwer-Gostomska, Małgorzata Pietrzykowska, Do
pmc-13079882.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Arterial hypertension is the main risk factor for cardiovascular diseases. It is characterized by inflammation and impaired generation of blood microvasculature leading to organ damage. While the immune system is an important actor involved in both phenomena, we hypothesized that hypertensive patients show alterations in numbers of regulatory T cells (Tregs) and proangiogenic CD31 + CXCR4+ T cell subsets, which lead to alterations in serum cytokine pattern and decreased generation of blood and lymphatic vessels.

pmc-13090519.title: Early trajectories of antibiotic exposure and colonization pressure and risk of ICU-acquired carbapenem-resistant Gram-negative bacteria: A prospective cohort study
pmc-13090519.creator: Zhihui Chen, Xiangru Ye, Jing Wu, Zhonghua Li, Sen Wang, Jing Wang, Yueru Tian, Shirong Li, Lei Zhou, Jie Ni, Yue Qu, Jialin Jin, Wenhong Zhang
pmc-13090519.description: BackgroundCarbapenem-resistant Gram-negative bacteria (CR-GNB) pose a critical threat in intensive care units (ICUs), with antibiotic exposure and colonization pressure identified as key associated factors. Prior studies have analyzed these two time-varying factors as static cumulative variables, obscuring heterogeneity in temporal patterns and their joint evolution. How distinct early trajectories of these factors jointly relate to CR-GNB acquisition risk remains unclear.

pmc-13201638.title: Injecting drug use worsens the quality of life in HIV-HCV co-infected patients in Vietnam
pmc-13201638.creator: Yoann Madec, Hanh Thi Hong Ngo, Tram Thi Phuong Pham, Nhung Thi Hong Le, Ha Thi Thu Nguyen, Jennifer Ilo van Nuil, Trang Trong Chu, Du Dinh Pham, Hieu Minh Tran, Hung Manh Lai, Linh Thi Thuy Doan, Tuan Anh Nguyen, Lan Trong Phan, Thang Hong Pham
pmc-13201638.description: In Vietnam, in 2024, the HIV prevalence was estimated at 0.4% accounting for approximatively 270,000 adult people living with HIV (PLHIV). PLHIV may also face hepatitis C virus (HCV) co-infection, although co-infection disproportionally affects people who inject drugs (PWID). It has been shown that usually, PLHIV have lower health-related quality of life (HRQoL) than HIV-negative individuals.

pmc-13226097.title: Equitable authorship in Global Gynecologic Oncology trials: the Asia Pacific Gynecologic Oncology Trials Group (APGOT) framework
pmc-13226097.creator: Jae-Weon Kim, Alison Evans, David Tan, Jung-Bok Lee, Jung-Yun Lee, Yoland Antill, Kosei Hasegawa, on behalf of the APGOT Investigators
pmc-13226097.description: hemi spheres, traditional authorship models rooted in individual or institutional contribution have struggled to accommodate the scale and complexity of modern cooperative research [1,2]. These pressures have mounted alongside the rapid growth of global clinical trials and structural changes within collaborative groups [3].

pmc-13293949.title: Synaptophysin autoantibodies mediate synaptic dysfunction in cerebellar ataxia
pmc-13293949.creator: Samantha Ho, Hoi Kiu Wong, Dorina Shqau, Stephan Winklmeier, Marcus Grobe-Einsler, Kevin Rostasy, Tania Kümpfel, Franziska S Thaler, Lior Brimberg, Marc A Schneider, Thomas Muley, Atay Vural, Thomas Seifert-Held, Verena Endmayr, Romana Höftberger, Jennifer Faber, Thomas Klopstock, Silke Frahm, Lisa
pmc-13293949.description: SummaryCerebellar ataxias (CAs) encompass a wide spectrum of genetic and sporadic origins, of which a portion is driven by immune-mediated pathomechanisms. While some patients harbor known autoantibodies, assisting diagnosis and treatment, many remain seronegative. Here, we identify synaptophysin (SYP) as an autoantigen in CA by serum IgG staining on primate tissue, combined with human protein array and cell-based assay (CBA).

pmc-13346423.title: Identifying limiting nutrients for wheat (Triticum aestivum L.) production in Halaba, Central Ethiopia
pmc-13346423.creator: Abay Ayalew, Moges Tadese
pmc-13346423.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Low wheat productivity in Ethiopia is largely attributed to nutrient imbalances and the widespread use of blanket fertilizer recommendations that do not account for site-specific soil conditions. To identify the most yield-limiting nutrients for wheat (Triticum aestivum L.) production, a field experiment using nutrient omission trials was conducted during the 2021 cropping season at eight farmers’ fields in Wera Dijo District, Halaba Zone, central Ethiopia.

pmc-13670708.title: Environmental change, risk perception, and adaptation: a study with extractivists of the Babaçu palm (Attalea speciosa Mart. ex Spreng) in an ecotonal environment in Northeastern Brazil
pmc-13670708.creator: Jayara de Sousa Lima, Juliana Loureiro Almeida Campos, André Luiz Borba do Nascimento
pmc-13670708.description: IntroductionClimate and socio-environmental changes have increased the risks to the livelihoods of traditional extractive communities. This study examines how babaçu coconut breaker perceive these risks and develop adaptive strategies based on traditional ecological knowledge in an ecotonal region of Northeast Brazil.
